hints.title: Unique Position Set
hints.text: Since all marbles at a location move together, only unique occupied positions matter.

hints.title: Set State Transition
hints.text: For each movement operation, remove the origin coordinate and insert the destination coordinate into the set.

hints.title: Sorted Order Result
hints.text: Extract and sort the resulting positions after applying all transfer steps.

hints.title: Set Relocation Code

complexity.notes: Hash set updates each move in O(1); sorting final unique positions takes O(k log k).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tracking individual marble locations wastes memory and time when position set suffices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that marble counts per position do not affect occupied coordinate tracking.
